title: Hamming (sphere-packing) bound
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet with $q = \abs{\alpha} > 1$ symbols, and let $C \subseteq \alpha^n$ be a code (a finite set of length-$n$ codewords) whose minimum Hamming distance is $d$, with $d > 0$. Then
\[
\abs{C} \;\le\; \frac{q^{\,n}}{\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{\lfloor (d-1)/2 \rfloor} \binom{n}{i}\,(q-1)^{i}}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a code of length $n$ over $\alpha$
replaced:
Let $q=|\alpha|>1$.  If $C\subseteq\alpha^n$ has minimum distance $d>0$, then
\[
|C|
\;\le\;
\frac{q^n}{\displaystyle\sum_{i=0}^{\lfloor(d-1)/2\rfloor}\binom{n}{i}(q-1)^i}.
\]
